verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense is explicitly marketed as 'AI-powered spend management' that automatically categorizes and ensures compliance for every transaction (docs-9), and BILL's platform includes an 'Invoice Coding Agent' for automatic AI bill coding (docs-8), suggesting some automated categorization/coding capability. However, there is no evidence of receipt OCR/reading, memo suggestion, or duplicate/fraud detection specifically for expense transactions. Missing for 10: explicit receipt-reading/OCR evidence, memo-suggestion detail, and duplicate or fraud detection functionality for Spend & Expense.
